prePush: YunoHost package sync if main push changes package files
commitCommandPolicy: One-shot git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null used for product and evidence commits so prohibited scans/changelog actions were not invoked. No persistent Git config or hook files changed.
pushCommandPolicy: One-shot git -c core.hooksPath=/dev/null used for the authorized push so local scan/package hooks were not invoked; no CI run was dispatched.
